subject: English
title: Letter z
prompt: Copy the letter carefully, then try it three times without any help.
teacher_note: Phase 3 grapheme. z is one of the 'Zigzag letters'. Start at the top — straight lines and sharp points, no curves. Say the sound as you form it.
curriculum_ref: EYFS ELG: Fine Motor Skills — hold a pencil effectively; begin to form letters correctly
